USD-notional OI changes with price and venue coverage differs.

support: Fuelmaps reports bids larger than asks at every displayed XRP depth band from ±0.5% to ±10%.

support: BLS payrolls exceeded the Reuters survey by 100,000.

Reuters reports higher yields and dollar immediately after release.
counterevidence: Reuters reports yields later pulled back and equity futures were positive at reporting.
No synchronized XRP/BTC/DXY/Treasury event return exists.

reasons: Kraken provider event timestamp and exact retrieval time are unavailable.

forecast.reason: The evidence supports competing market-structure explanations but does not satisfy the synchronized point-in-time dataset and out-of-sample evaluation standard.
